turns.q: My budget is moderate, what would make a good gift in that range?
turns.replyTail: IPSY Original is usually the sweet spot: it’s $15/month and includes five deluxe-size beauty samples (worth up to $70). If you want it to feel more like a bigger treat (still not wildly pricey), IPSY Extra is $32/month + $1.99 shipping and comes with five full-size products (worth up to $200). To gift either one: visit IPSY.com, and at the top of the page you’ll see a banner for gifting subscriptions. Click the banner, then choose IPSY Original or IPSY Extra and pick a 3-, 6-, or 12-month plan.
